steps.what: Retrieve patient measures and verify comparable observations before and after interventions
Compare verified measures in dated tables without inferring clinical improvement
Interpret patients' progress considering measurement limits and competing explanations

tasks.design: Build dated comparison tables from clinician-verified measures in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The clinician checks comparability and interprets change; arithmetic differences never become automatic treatment-effect claims.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual alignment of assessment dates and measures adds repeated handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed joins and difference calculations can assemble verified observations.
tasks.still_hard: Practice effects, timing and other clinical changes complicate interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician distinguishes observed change from evidence of treatment benefit.

reach.learn: Sources of bias in before-and-after comparisons

evidence.claim: Dated tables and fixed calculations can organise checked measures, while causal and clinical interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Scope starts with completed clinical assessments; collecting those observations remains in assessment tasks and earns no saving here.

In s1 the clinician produces patient identifier, measure/version, date, score/unit, intervention type/date, source reference and explicit comparability decision. Retrieval and all capture are counted in the 35% step; missing or incompatible values are listed for manual investigation.
Test native longitudinal views before custom code; existing automatic chart runtime earns no labour saving.
No automatic improvement, clinical significance or treatment recommendation flags.
research_questions: Does verified table assembly save time after clinical comparability checks?

incremental.description: Mapping maintenance and extra output checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross=25%; minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 19%. Range 0-5% covers existing charting and difficult alignment; unmeasured E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Participate in educational programs and workshops and critically apply new methods

tasks.design: Retain participation, practice and critical learning. Existing {LMS} may provide content and attendance records; neither establishes a saving in learning time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional competence requires understanding and practice.
tasks.enabler_now: No replacement of learning participation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether a new method fits a patient population.

evidence.claim: Summaries and attendance automation do not replace learning participation or establish a clerical baseline here.

assumptions: Scope is participation and learning, not course administration.
No automatic competence or completion input is required.
Unchanged process has no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which learning methods best support transfer to practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; learning time is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Educate and supervise trainees and staff

steps.what: Educate and supervise students, interns and staff through observation and feedback

tasks.design: Retain observation, instruction and feedback with the supervisor. {DOCS} can hold existing teaching materials without replacing direct supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feedback must respond to actual practice and the learner's understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation of supervision is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe reasoning and developing professional judgement.

reach.learn: How to assess developing clinical reasoning

evidence.claim: Direct clinical teaching and supervision require observation and feedback; no separate administrative saving is established.

assumptions: Only teaching and supervision are counted, without invented attendance paperwork.
research_questions: Which supervision situations need more observed practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; direct supervision time is retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and implement cognitive rehabilitation plans

steps.what: Design and implement rehabilitation plans with patients and adapt to observed responses

tasks.design: Keep rehabilitation design and implementation with the clinician and patient. Existing {DOCS} can hold plans, but formatting a plan does not establish a reduction in individual clinical work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans must fit cognitive limitations, goals and daily circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated selection or implementation of rehabilitation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting activities when progress differs from expectations.
tasks.human_edge: Joint goal setting and responsive clinical judgement.

reach.learn: How cognitive and psychological needs interact

evidence.claim: Individual rehabilitation design and delivery are clinical work; no repeatable clerical baseline is established in this task.

assumptions: Clinical design and delivery are both retained; report writing is separate.
The clinician observes responses during counted care; no free readiness or progress flag is assumed.
Use current plan records without a new application.
No new upkeep because the workflow is unchanged.
unknowns: Current rehabilitation methods and patient goals
research_questions: Where do individual adaptations most often change the plan?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no rehabilitation design or delivery time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical care supported by reliable progress comparisons
reach: Review longitudinal measurement with research colleagues
role.ambitious_version: Verified comparison tables support clinical understanding while care, learning and supervision retain their time.
